en-US:
Temporary chat now reuses normal chat and voice input, with configured, authorized read-only tools and a compact header menu. Backgrounding preserves it; leaving cancels and discards it. Keep saves the chat without resending. Speech recognition follows your usual settings and may use an online service.
Subagents can discover tools and Skills without loading the entire catalog at startup. Improves shared-Linux command and terminal ownership, independent cancellation, environment handling and lifecycle coordination.
Repairs composer layout recursion, notification callback paths and Linux output-pressure handling. Release interpreter optimization is included for device retesting; component and Simulator results do not replace physical-device acceptance. Internal Floe QA only.
CAD supports task-authorized edits without a separate workbench grant for each step, continuous proposal/apply workflows, Chinese names and clearer extrusion examples. The Canvas entry is now simply 3D Workbench. Reduces review interruptions for ordinary document/media edits and routine local Linux commands; repository writes and risky remote operations follow the task approval mode.
zh-Hans:
临时会话复用正常聊天界面和语音输入，通过顶部精简菜单管理，并按实际配置与授权提供只读工具。切后台保留，真正离开则取消并销毁；保留为正式会话不重复发送请求。语音识别沿用正常设置，所选服务可能在线处理。
子助手可自行发现工具和 Skill，修复工具目录过大导致无法启动的问题。完善共享 Linux 环境中的命令与终端归属、独立取消、环境参数和启停协调。
修复输入框布局递归和通知回调相关路径，以及 Linux 输出压力处理。发布构建包含解释器吞吐优化，性能需实机复测；组件和模拟器结果不代替真机验收。本轮仅 Floe QA 内部测试。
CAD 接入任务授权，普通编辑无需逐项到工作台确认，提案不再强制打断任务；完善中文名称和拉伸参数示例。画布入口简化为“3D 工作台”。普通文档、媒体编辑及本地 Linux 例行命令减少审核打断，代码库写入和远端风险操作仍遵循任务审批模式。
